nodes.label: Use Direct LGMD Face-Compaction for First 3ds Max Edited-Mesh Tier
nodes.rationale: Direct LGMD writing avoids the BSP path's duplicate-point/sliver-polygon failures; the tier is scoped to preserve original vertices while only allowing whole-face deletion until a full mesh compiler exists.

nodes.label: Funk Mesh Forearm Trim Confirmed Live in AE
nodes.rationale: Funk Mesh v0.4.0-nodefix became the active path once forearm-trim edits loaded and rendered in AE with animations intact, fixing header face-count and BSP node-offset remap bugs.

nodes.label: Suppress Native Offhand Viewmodel Animation via Squirrel JointPos
nodes.rationale: Rather than modifying the Max exporter, a Squirrel handler overrides JointPos after AE's native update so gun animation is preserved while VR hand visuals take over specific joints.

nodes.label: Include an Existing-Save Patcher in Final SS2VR Tooling
nodes.rationale: An offline patcher that defaults to writing a copy (in-place only behind --in-place with a timestamped backup) is safer than unreliable live console injection into a running save.

nodes.label: Reconcile Phase Numbering Across Repo Docs and Google Sheet
nodes.rationale: PROJECT_PHASES.md and the Google Sheet are made canonical with expanded status values (YES/BUILT/EXPLORING/NO) so drifted parallel edits stop diluting progress tracking.

nodes.label: Stage Manual Reloads, Holsters, and World Physics as Squirrel/OpenXR Design Tracks
nodes.rationale: Reloads/holsters dispatch native KEX commands and physics starts log-only/whitelisted, since KEX already owns weapon/ammo state and Dark objects can be mission-critical or invisible.

nodes.label: Add Two-Handed Long Weapon Handling as a Tracked Design Path
nodes.rationale: A primary-right-hand plus secondary-left-support constraint model, staged log-only then pose-only then projectile, avoids two hands independently and unstably writing weapon pose.

nodes.label: Slim CURRENT_STATE.md into a Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Because every session reads CURRENT_STATE.md first, test queues/evidence/failures/theories are moved to dedicated docs so context bloat there does not bury the active blocker.

nodes.label: Reopen Latency with a Staged Recovery Ladder
nodes.rationale: Rather than reverting directly to authoritative rendering, latency work is restaged through bounded steps since earlier failures may have been contaminated by since-fixed pitch/yaw bugs.

nodes.label: Use Old Dark Engine Source as a Contract Reference
nodes.rationale: darkengine-main is treated as a source-confirmed contract reference, not a direct AE symbol map, validating existing semantic frob, projectile redirect, and world_scale choices.

nodes.label: Triage Additional Nightdive Source Dump
nodes.rationale: The secondary source dump is byte-identical to darkengine-main for key SS2 files and is used only for release-header/Dreamcast lookups when the cleaner tree does not answer the question.

nodes.label: Split FlatAim Reticle, Projectile, Weapon, and Picker Calibration
nodes.rationale: Visible reticle sign, projectile angular compensation, weapon-follow sign, and native picker mapping are treated as four independent calibration domains so fixing one does not regress an already-tuned one.

nodes.label: Move FlatAim Pickup Selection off Native Flat-Pixel Tuning
nodes.rationale: FlatAim reuses SS2VR's semantic-selection architecture (world ray to Squirrel scan to engine frob publish-back) because piling flat-pixel offsets onto the native cursor picker was already a proven dead end.

nodes.label: Hide FlatAim Stock Crosshair Through KPF Asset Override
nodes.rationale: After the Win32 overlay cover rendered as a black square, the stock crosshair is instead suppressed by packaging a transparent iface/CROSSHAI.png asset override, lower risk than a native draw hook.

nodes.label: Treat Smooth-Turn Transport as Its Own KEX Accumulator Calibration
nodes.rationale: Smooth turn gets its own smooth_turn_pixels_per_degree gain plus a fixed kexMouseSign convention, fixing a proven half-rate/opposite-sign bug causing 180/720-degree reconvergence.

nodes.label: Start Floating UI Panels with OpenXR Source-Rect Crop
nodes.rationale: The first floating-panel spike reuses the existing UI swapchain cropped via XrSwapchainSubImage.imageRect and stays visual-only so panel placement cannot steal existing interaction routing.

nodes.label: Use OpenXR Cylinder Layers for the First Curved HUD Spike
nodes.rationale: Native XR_KHR_composition_layer_cylinder composition is reused for curved panels instead of a custom tessellated D3D HUD, falling back to flat quad when unsupported.

nodes.label: Treat Native Shock Overlays as the Long-Term HUD Split Source
nodes.rationale: The real dismantled HUD/inventory system should be built from the engine's own gOverlayRects table or D3D draw-call classification rather than hand-maintained screenshot percentage crops.

nodes.label: Probe Weapon/Viewmodel World-Depth Occlusion Before Writing Depth State
nodes.rationale: A log-only D3D11 probe for depth clear/state transitions is added before attempting a depth-preservation patch, since RenderDoc evidence needs live runtime confirmation first.

nodes.label: Restore FlatAim's Native Crosshair and Make Semantic Publish-Back Capture-Only
nodes.rationale: The KPF crosshair override and topmost overlay are dropped in favor of the original crosshair, and ss2fa_hl becomes a swallowed DLL-private channel after a save-load crash traced near the hover-candidate scorer.

nodes.label: Gate FlatAim Config Publishing on a Live Squirrel Heartbeat
nodes.rationale: The DLL must not publish ss2fa_* traffic or suppress mouse look unless a private ss2fa_alive heartbeat proves ss2fa.nut is loaded and ticking, since a shadowed Squirrel half was silently missed.

nodes.label: Save Patcher Defaults to Bottom/List-Last Insertion
nodes.rationale: The save patcher's default insertion position is flipped from first to last after live testing proved top-of-list was the opposite of the load priority needed for SS2VR's mod to actually run.

nodes.label: Additive Left-Hand Viewmodel Spike Remains Render-Proof First
nodes.rationale: The v1.15 spike only proves a second CameraObj viewmodel can render at all with a visible offset; it is not called true left-hand tracking until a real left-hand pose channel exists.

nodes.label: FlatAim Config-Setter Hook Is Opt-In for Crash Isolation
nodes.rationale: The KexSetConfigRaw hook is made opt-in (config_hook=0 default) to isolate it as a suspect after a save-load crash, given the heartbeat-gated build already proved stale publishing.

nodes.label: FlatAim Blocks F5 When the Squirrel Bridge Is Absent
nodes.rationale: F5 free-aim is fail-closed unless the ss2fa_alive heartbeat is fresh, since Ghidra proved the crash RVA was a native cursor-mode helper unrelated to the FlatAim config hook.

nodes.label: Use Clean Post-Debug-View Saves for FlatAim Functional Tests
nodes.rationale: The old Flataim save is treated as contaminated (possibly created during debug view) and a freshly created, debug-view-free save becomes the baseline for further testing.

nodes.label: Restore FlatAim Bridge for Clean-Save Testing
nodes.rationale: config_hook is re-enabled on the clean save baseline since the clean save loaded successfully, weakening the theory that the DLL config bridge itself crashes save-load.

nodes.label: Patch the Correct FlatAim Save with FlatAim Last in KEX Load List
nodes.rationale: Live condump proved the save-patcher's displayed order was reversed relative to KEX's actual Mods to load list, so the correct save was re-identified and FlatAim needed to be list-last in the patcher.

nodes.label: Revert FlatAim to Above-sshock2ee Convention and Remove Requirements Metadata
nodes.rationale: The FlatAim-after-sshock2ee ordering assumption is rejected after live condump still showed no [SS2FA] load, reverting to the earlier working above-sshock2ee order and dropping requirements metadata.

nodes.label: Package FlatAim KPF as ZIP/PK so KEX Mounts kpf:/mods/flataim/
nodes.rationale: The FlatAim KPF is repacked as a proper ZIP/PK archive after discovering the installed archive began with raw sq_scripts bytes instead of a PK header, so KEX's kpf:/mods/flataim/ path never resolved.

nodes.label: Try Native Cursor Globals Before Returning to Synthetic FlatAim Reticles
nodes.rationale: With the Squirrel bridge confirmed live, the least-invasive next step to move the visible original crosshair is writing FlatAim's pixel into KEX's native cursor globals rather than re-enabling the topmost overlay.

nodes.label: Keep Weapon CameraObj Yaw/Pitch Controller-Local; Apply HMD Roll Only
nodes.rationale: Full HMD-rotation compensation on the visible weapon CameraObj is reverted because it dragged the gun with head movement; only HMD roll correction is retained with increased smoothing.

nodes.label: Principle: New Bridges Default Log-Only or Fail-Closed Until Proven Live
nodes.rationale: Across reload/holster physics, viewmodel probes, and FlatAim's Squirrel bridge, new interaction systems start default-off/log-only or refuse to activate until a live heartbeat or render proof confirms the other half is actually running.

nodes.label: Principle: Reuse Engine/KEX-Owned State Instead of Reimplementing Game Logic
nodes.rationale: Manual reloads, holsters, offhand animation suppression, and FlatAim selection all route through existing KEX/AE-owned commands or Squirrel semantic scanning rather than re-deriving weapon/ammo/pick logic in the mod.

nodes.label: Principle: Keep Each Doc Scoped to Its Purpose to Protect Context Budget
nodes.rationale: Because always-read docs like CURRENT_STATE.md and the phase tracker are loaded into every session, content is routed to the doc matching its purpose instead of duplicating it inline.
